verdict.rationale: Qdrant's GitHub README says it offers client libraries and lists Go, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python and Java clients (plus Rust and .NET), covering all four languages in the story. The quickstart shows Python client usage, and a community user confirms smooth onboarding with the Python client. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation evidence for the TypeScript, Go and Java SDKs, and hands-on corroboration beyond Python.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build against official SDKs in the major languages (Python, TypeScript, Go, Java)

citations.quote: Qdrant offers the following client libraries to help you integrate it into your application stack
Go client ... Rust client ... JavaScript/TypeScript client ... Python client ... .NET/C# client ... Java client
Just played with qdrant using its Python client. Pretty smooth onboarding experience
